product_name: Alcatel V3 Classic 5G (Halo White, 6GB+128GB) | India’s 1st NXTVISION Display | 50MP AI Dual Camera | NFC, 2TB Expandable Memory | Gemini in-Built | MediaTek 6300 | with Charger
description: India’s 1st NXTVISION 120Hz Display - Enjoy stunning clarity on a 6.67" HD+ anti-glare display with ultra-smooth 120Hz refresh rate. Get sharper detail, vibrant color accuracy, and immersive viewing - perfect for gaming, binge-watching, and everyday use. 50MP AI Camera with Smart Imaging - Capture every moment with a 50MP AI main camera and 8MP front camera. AI enhancement delivers ultra-clear photos and selfies with natural color and sharp detail - ideal for social-ready photography in any light. Built-In Gemini AI + 5G Power - Boost productivity and creativity with Gemini AI for instant summaries, Magic Editor, Magic Eraser, and more. Backed by 5G, powerful MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor, and smart home support for smooth performance all day. Massive Storage & Battery Life - Store more with 128GB internal storage (expandable up to 2TB) and enjoy smooth multitasking with 16GB RAM (6GB + 10GB expandable RAM). Stay powered longer with a 5200mAh battery and 18W charger included in-box. Secure, Durable & Immersive Experience - Stay protected with IP54 splash and dust resistance and enjoy secure payments via built-in NFC. Dual stereo speakers deliver rich, immersive sound for music, gaming, and entertainment. Plus, with 3 years of OS updates and 4 years of security updates, you’re assured long-term performance and protection.
